messages:
karina: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — can we map the three phases you showed to concrete owners and launch windows? trying to update the product plan before EOD.

sam: phasing recap: phase 1 = API surface + basic console flows, phase 2 = Optimize features + perf tuning, phase 3 = dedicated/private rollouts.

elena: for phase 1 ownership: product -> karina, PMM -> nina, eng-platform -> sam. target window = mid-May to early June (rough).
mohit: for phase 2 we need a perf gate — we shouldn't start public beta until 95th p50 latency targets meet the SLO on dedicated runners. I'm estimating 6-8 weeks after phase 1.
tim: question re: console UX scope in phase 1 — are we shipping the new model selector or just the simplified route-level controls? need clarity to size.
karina: good catch, tim. phase 1 ships route-level controls only. model selector is phase 2. i'll update the deck.
jay: dependency callout — infra needs the rollout policy API from eng-runtime to support canary by model-variant. current ETA from runtime is 2 weeks.
mohit: +1 on dependency. if runtime slips, Optimize's adaptive batching feature (phase 2) will be blocked. can we get a contingency plan?
elena: contingency: temporary fallback is to use tag-based routing on Dedicated pools; config lives in infra-config repo. nina can we document that in the runbook?
nina: will do, adding a short doc and runbook section by tomorrow noon. @karina do you want the PR linked from the plan?
karina: yes please. that makes the plan auditable.
deploy-bot: Canary started: console/phase1 v2026.05.12-canary (10% traffic) — monitor: console/canary-dashboard -> https://dash.internal/reports/console-canary
mohit: saw the canary. heads-up: we're seeing a small increase in tail GC during long-running sessions — tagging @sam and @tim.
sam: logging an infra task to investigate tail GC and potential mem growth. assigning to eng-runtime.
tim: for timelines: can we lock phase 1 freeze by May 6 so we can do a 1-week canary window and ship May 14 if all good?
karina: locking May 6 for freeze. callout to PMs to finalize prompts/case studies by May 3.
jay: noted. i'll push the runtime API PR earlier this week to reduce risk. :thumbsup:
karina: thanks all — I'll update the roadmap slide and post an action-item checklist. if anyone wants to pair on the contingency runbook, ping me.
